Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 40
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded that Trader Joe’s met the requirements without verifying two critical constraints: (1) proximity—whether a specific Trader Joe’s location is within 2 blocks of the Lincoln Park boundary, and (2) price—whether ready-to-eat salads at that specific store are listed under $15. The conclusion relied on a generic product category page (which often lacks prices) and did not confirm geospatial distance, resulting in an unsupported and incomplete answer.
